title: Airport flight from mallworld
content: Has anyone actually taken a flight from the Mallworld Airport and gotten to their destination? I have no clue where I am going.. but it's the sketchiest tiny little sci fi plane, a few unrecognizable people onboard, im scared and lost, and it always ends up in the ocean. Oh and its a total pain in the ass to get there and never have my credentials.. and one misstep, or get off a creepy elevator on the wrong floor, walk down the wrong hall.. and im right back in the mall.. Anyone??
